metadata.first_call_definition: First simulate on a fresh CoPylot/GpuContext. Backend probe and process runtime initialization recorded separately; not a cold CUDA process.
metadata.monitoring: No GPU process initially; sole API-probe process whitelisted; poll every 2 s plus case boundaries; memory <=1024 MiB, no thermal slowdown. No concurrent builds/tests.
metadata.simulate_wall_definition: perf_counter around public simulate including its profiling/timing CSV writes; all extraction/parsing/telemetry outside this interval

map_representation: Piecewise constant equal-area cells from normalized Hermite midpoint samples; not true integrated cell averages.
map_orientation: Rows increase from receiver bottom after C API vertical reversal. Columns follow native decreasing azimuth; s starts at native clockwise seam.
performance_policy: Plain public simulate wall time, no diagnostic CSV/events; compiled coarse scopes retained. CPU first + 1 warmup excluded; CUDA first + 2 warmups excluded. No concurrent server jobs.

bands.energy_reason: The dimensional integral is normalized to delivered heliostat power; independent spatial energy accuracy is not identified by this invariant.
